alex: Quick async standup — API GW / routing / auth / rate limits
alex: Yesterday: finished routing rule rename + added compatibility shim for old service tokens. Pushed config to feature branch.
alex: Blocker: staging rate-limit policy is intermittently returning 429s for internal health checks; couldn't reproduce locally.
alex: Today: debug staging policy, open PR for token migration, follow up on canary plan.
sarah: thx alex. pinging @mike on the 429s — saw anything similar in prod-metrics? :thinking_face:
sarah: also FYI i left a review on your PR (repo: infra/api-gateway, #487). small nits, mainly docs and one test.
mike: I saw the 429 blips early this morning, looked like short token bucket bursts when traffic spikes from synthetic checks. I can dig into logs after standup.
mike: quick note — when you repro add this to the curl to mimic healthcheck headers: `-H "X-Internal-Check: synth"`
jordan: canary update: I kicked the canary for the new routing rules to staging at 06:15. Deploy bot said success but we saw 2 requests routed to old variant (~0.1%).
jordan: putting a short watch on it for next hour. no errors so far.
emma: on auth side, I merged the service token migration helper into auth-service:main. Backwards compat enabled by default for 48h.
emma: also added a quick rollback script: `scripts/rollback-token-compat.sh` — run in ops container.
alex: thanks all. @sarah re: PR i'll address your nits today. @mike can you attach the log snippets you find?
mike: will do. initial hint: see `gateway/router:rate` traces in logs-archive — filter with `level=warn` and `route=auth-proxy`.
sarah: CI note — tests flaked on `TestRateLimiterConcurrency` in staging runs. reran once and passed. leaving a TODO to add a deterministic seed.
jordan: FYI I'll open a tiny follow-up to tighten the canary traffic to 0.05% until we validate rate heuristics.
deploy-bot: canary deployment: infra/api-gateway@feature/routing-compat -> staging successful (canary=0.1%) | 1725202345
alex: deploy-bot — can you pause the canary if 5xx rate > 0.5% for 5m?
deploy-bot: automated policy: will pause canary if 5xx_rate >= 0.5% over 5m window. alert posted to #incidents.
emmma_typo: (ignore)
emma: small ask — can someone sanity check the docs I added under /docs/routing/policies? just a quick pass for clarity.
sarah: i can do a docs pass after lunch.
mike: attaching log excerpt (pastebin): https://paste.redwood.dev/abc123 — shows bursts around 06:12-06:18.
alex: great. next steps: (1) mike to collect logs + correlate with synthetic checks (2) sarah to finish PR review & CI seed fix (3) jordan to lower canary traffic slightly (4) emma to confirm rollback script exec path.
alex: if anyone hits a hard blocker DM me. otherwise i'll post a follow-up with any changes to the staging policy. :thumbsup:
